title: New Affordable Housing Opens in Rancho Bernardo Transit Center Parking Lot
description:
Join us live for the grand opening of a new mixed-use affordable housing development in Rancho Bernardo within steps of the Metropolitan Transit System (MTS) station on George Cooke Express Drive.
